responsibility: Defines the RL78 machine-description patterns for actual hardware instructions after virtual registers have been resolved to real RL78 registers. It describes concrete opcode-emitting insns, their alternatives and constraints, flag-tracking behavior via the update_Z attribute, real-register move/arithmetic/shift/branch sequences, and late peephole optimizations that compress nearby RTL into better RL78 encodings, forming the final instruction-selection layer that corresponds directly to executable RL78 opcodes.
